messages:
rachel_fin: spotted odd -$1,950 'capacity correction' on Meridian invoice INV-2028-1105. invoice shows $48,050 but our commit calc is $50,000.
omar_ops: pulling billgen logs, one sec.
billing-bot: auto-match: INV-2028-1105 -> commit C-MER-2028Q1. adjustment detected: CAPACITY_CORRECTION -1950.
lucy_sales: Meridian did a mid-quarter commit swap on 2028-03-01. did they request any credits?
rachel_fin: sales notes show swap request but no credit memos. invoice placed on AR hold.
omar_ops: billgen excerpt: "BILLGEN INFO invoice=INV-2028-1105 base=50000 adjustments=[CAPACITY_PRORATE:-975,CAPACITY_PRORATE:-975] total=48050". looks like proration applied twice.
billing-bot: ticket BG-9801 opened for duplicate proration emission.
lucy_sales: Meridian prefers corrected invoice rather than retrospective charge. they asked for ETA.
cfo_sylvia: approve hotfix and regen. pre-authorize up to $2,000 goodwill if customer pushes back. finance to file memo FIN-6001.
omar_ops: hotfix PR created to dedupe proration events by migration_id. targeting deploy in 4h, regen overnight. will post deploy logs.
rachel_fin: thanks — will hold collection and update Meridian with 48h ETA.
